title: tmpspec
description: This mod allows any player to switch to spectator mode at any almost any point in time. However when they switch back they will be put back where they were when they switched into spectator mode
body:
This mod allows any player to access spectator mode on any account without giving them OP or allowing them to use spectator mode to tavle long distances. This mod can effecitvlky act as a vinilla friendly alterntive to free cam.

This mod adds the command `/specswap`, When run in survial mode it will store the current player location and put the player into spectator mode. When run in spectator mode it will move the player back to where they were when they enterd spectator mode and set them to survival mode.
